rust_summary: a mod menu for a player's item through `Host` (`native_open_item_menu`).
doc_summary: `native_open_item_menu` reaches `Host` as `open_item_menu(player, menu, title, items, extra)`: a native-slots menu of the mod menu type, with the items in its slots and the extra data as its menu-extra payload, opening at a positionless stand-in so no block is named. Bundles need "helpers": @API:open_item_menu@.
